'''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Brazil relations]], [[Argentina–Venezuela relations]], [[International reactions to the 2026 United States intervention in Venezuela]]
**[[Brazil]] returns responsibility to [[Argentina]] for its diplomatic representation and custody of the [[List of diplomatic missions of Argentina|Argentine embassy]] in Venezuela after overseeing the mission in [[Caracas]] since 2024 following the expulsion of Argentine diplomats under the [[Nicolás Maduro]] [[Presidency of Nicolás Maduro|administration]]. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Egyptian parliamentary election]]
**[[Egypt]]'s [[National Elections Authority]] finalizes the remaining 49 [[Parliament of Egypt|parliamentary]] seats, confirming that [[President of Egypt|President]] [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]]'s allies retain the two-thirds  [[supermajority]] needed to [[Constitutional amendment|amend]] the [[Constitution of Egypt|constitution]], while [[List of political parties in Egypt|opposition parties]] and [[Independent politician|independents]] hold about 158 of 568 elected seats. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/egypt-announces-results-last-seats-parliament-vote-that-gave-sisi-strong-2026-01-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[Nicaragua–United States relations]]
**[[Nicaragua]] releases dozens of prisoners after the United States publicly demanded the release of more than 60 [[Politics of Nicaragua|political prisoners]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/1/10/nicaragua-frees-dozens-of-prisoners-amid-pressure-from-trump-administration (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2025 Honduran general election]]
**The Chief of the Joint Chiefs of Staff of the [[Armed Forces of Honduras|Honduran Armed Forces]] Héctor Valerio informs that the already confirmed election results and the transfer of power would be guaranteed despite [[President of Honduras|President]] [[Xiomara Castro]]'s decree demanding a recount of the results. [https://tiempo.hn/honduras/2026/01/10/hector-valerio-al-pueblo-confien-en-las-ffaa-garantizaremos-la-alternancia-del-poder/ (''Tiempo'')]
